detailed_descriptions.en: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players. Read it. Type it. Eliminate. Get a clear look at an opponent’s forehead and type their number to take them out. Keep moving, watch who’s looking your way, and try to remember those digits when the pressure hits. Make yourself harder to read Blind opponents with flashbangs, block their view with smoke grenades, and draw their attention away with distract grenades. Disrupt their next move with stun grenades, hinder their escape with slow grenades, and set traps to catch them off guard. Use your items to create an opening when getting a good look is easier said than done. Get a better look Use binoculars to read numbers and eliminate distant targets, or snap a photo with your camera that stays visible for a few seconds. Sometimes, an extra moment to read those digits is all you need. Capture flags. Rack up eliminations. Fight for yourself in Deathmatch, join forces in Team Deathmatch, or push for the enemy flag in Capture the Flag. Make every teammate count in round-based Team Elimination, or outlast everyone in Last Man Standing. Every mode gives you a different reason to get close... and a very good reason to watch your forehead. Bring your friends. Meet your next targets. Play with friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players. Face off against your group or team up against the opposition. You might trust your friends, but you probably shouldn’t let them read your number.
